Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a Tandem Affinity Purification (TAP) approach to identify AKT2 interaction partners, combined with SILAC for quantification. Acquisition is DDA (Top10). Search parameters include phosphorylation (pSTY) and N-terminal acetylation.

scope: we performed AKT2-protein interaction analysis to elucidate their relevance for AKT2-dependent cellular functions. We identified heat shock protein 90 kDa (HSP90), Cdc37, heat shock protein 70 kDa (HSP70), 78 kDa glucose regulated protein (GRP78), tubulin, GAPDH, α-enolase and elongation factor 2 (EF2) as AKT2-interacting proteins by a combination of tandem affinity purification and mass spectrometry in HEK293T cells.
AKT2-Tag protein and bound interaction partners were purified via anti-FLAG M2 and Strep-Tactin Sepharose beads.
To digest TAP purified proteins in solution 8 M urea was added to the concentrated sample.
